usage: As a noun, '增肌' (zang1 gei1) refers to the process or activity of building muscle mass.
'增肌' is commonly used in fitness and bodybuilding contexts to describe muscle growth goals.
You can use '增肌' as the object of a sentence, for example, '我想做多啲增肌運動' ('I want to do more muscle-building exercises').
It can be paired with verbs related to exercise or diet to describe actions taken to build muscle.
'增肌' can also be used in phrases describing specific plans or diets for muscle gain.
